     7	/-!
     8	# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum
     9	
    10	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
    11	ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
    12	modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
    13	that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
    14	`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
    15	`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
    16	restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.
    17	
    18	This is deliberately only the native-module bridge.  It does not assert
    19	`IsLineBundle`, pushforward base-change, or existence of a tied
    20	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation`; those remain genuine producer obligations.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    32	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    34	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    35	
    36	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    41	
    42	/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.
    43	
    44	The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
    45	are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
    46	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    47	    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    48	      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
    49	  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    50	    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
    51	  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    52	      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    53	    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
    54	  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    55	    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    56	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    57	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    58	    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)
    59	
    60	/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
    61	noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
    62	  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    63	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
    64	  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    65	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    66	    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
    67	  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    68	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
    69	  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    70	    intro X Y f r m
    71	    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
    72	        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
    73	      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
    74	        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
    75	        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
    76	    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
    77	    apply Subtype.ext
    78	    funext j
    79	    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    80	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])
    81	
    82	/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/
    83	noncomputable def nativeModule : (relCurve C B).Modules := by
    84	  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
    85	  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
    86	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
    87	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    88	    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    89	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    90	    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
    91	  all_goals rfl
    92	
    93	/-- On every open, restricting `D.nativeModule` to the coefficient ring recovers
    94	the datum's original module of sections.
    95	
    96	The equivalence is the identity on sections. Its linearity is the substantive
    97	point: `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies the native structure-sheaf action
    98	of a coefficient scalar with the datum's coefficient action. -/
    99	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv
   100	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
   101	    (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   102	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[B]
   103	      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) := by
   104	  let f :
   105	      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   106	        (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) →ₗ[B]
   107	        D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) :=
   108	    { toFun := fun x => x
   109	      map_add' := by
   110	        intros
   111	        rfl
   112	      map_smul' := by
   113	        intro r x
   114	        change gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
   115	            ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B U r) x =
   116	          r • (show D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) from x)
   117	        exact gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap B D.pieces D.unit
   118	          (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x }
   119	  exact LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun y => ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩
   120	
   121	/-- The base-ring sheaf of `D.nativeModule` is canonically the datum sheaf.
   122	
   123	This has exactly the type of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.module_iso` when the
   124	presentation's native module is chosen to be `D.nativeModule`. -/
   125	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSheafIso :
   126	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   127	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D) ≅ D.sheaf :=
   128	  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
   129	    (NatIso.ofComponents
   130	      (fun U => (nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv D U.unop).toModuleIso)
   131	      (fun {_ _} _ => by
   132	        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
   133	        apply LinearMap.ext
   134	        intro x
   135	        rfl))
   136	
   137	end

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/

    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
    87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    90	  h0_rank_one :
    91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

   104	/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.
   105	
   106	This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
   107	noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   108	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   109	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   110	    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]
   111	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=

   115	/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
   116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj

   120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
   121	      P.module :=

   123	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module

   126	
   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
   128	
   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
   130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
   141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
   142	    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)

   144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
   145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
   154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
   155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
   156	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   158	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   159	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)

   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)

   262	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]

   264	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :

   270	/-- The linear map underlying the canonical base-changed datum-section construction. -/
   271	noncomputable def datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap
   272	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)

   274	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :

   277	        (op (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) :=
   278	  ((P.h0BaseChange B).trans
   279	    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀

   285	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   286	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   287	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   288	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :

   294	-- The composed H⁰ equivalences create a large dependent linear-map elaboration.
   295	/-- Equality of localized H⁰ generators transports canonically to the associated datum
   296	sections.  This exposes the linearity used by fixed-open divisor canonicality without choosing
   297	a second section comparison. -/
   298	theorem datumSectionBaseChange_eq_smul_of_tensor_eq
   299	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   300	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   301	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   302	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) (v : B)
   303	    (h : (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y' =
   304	      v • ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)) :
   305	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y' =
   306	      v • P.datumSectionBaseChange B y := by
   307	  rw [← P.datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap_one_tmul B y',
   308	    ← P.datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap_one_tmul B y,
   309	    ← map_smul, h]

   311	/-- The conditional divisor datum cut by a base-changed presentation section.
   312	
   313	The explicit `hsec` hypothesis is the non-vacuous fibrewise nonvanishing input.  It is
   314	converted componentwise to the injectivity required by the fibrewise-regular section
   315	construction; the integral fibre instance is installed from the standing geometrically
   316	irreducible curve hypotheses.

     9	/-!
    10	# Rank-one fibre reduction for the chart colength
    11	
    12	This is the geometric wrapper around `RankOneFibre`: the genuine chart-reading ideal is mapped
    13	to `B/(read s)`, and that image is definitionally `chartIdealColengthModule`.  Thus a pointwise
    14	span statement for the fibre of the ideal immediately gives the desired vanishing of the
    15	colength fibre.  The span statement is allowed to include the zero-fibre case.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	open scoped TensorProduct
    25	
    26	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    27	
    28	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    29	
    30	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    31	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    32	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {a : ℕ}
    33	
    34	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
    35	
    36	/-- **Pointwise chart-colength fibre vanishing from ideal-fibre span.**  Let `B` be the
    37	pinned-chart section ring, `J` the genuine `B`-ideal generated by the readings of `K`, and
    38	`I = (read s)` for `s ∈ K`.  If every vector of
    39	`κ(p) ⊗[B] J` is a scalar multiple of `1 ⊗ read(s)`, then the image of `J` in `B/I` has
    40	zero `κ(p)`-fibre.  This is the exact single-point input consumed by the `κ(z)` RD-N bridge;
    41	it uses no global base-fibre or flatness inference. -/
    42	theorem subsingleton_chartIdealColengthModule_tensor_residueField_of_ideal_span
    43	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
    44	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) (hsK : s ∈ K)
    45	    (p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
    46	    (hspan : ∀ v : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[
    47	        Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)]
    48	        (chartReadIdeal K b), ∃ c : p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
    49	          c • ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[
    50	            Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)]
    51	            (⟨relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s,
    52	              by
    53	                exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨s, hsK⟩, rfl⟩⟩ :
    54	              chartReadIdeal K b)) = v) :
    55	    Subsingleton ((chartIdealColengthModule K b s) ⊗[
    56	      Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    57	  let B : Type u := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
    58	  let I : Ideal B := Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s}
    59	  let P : Submodule B B := chartReadIdeal K b
    60	  let f : B →ₗ[B] (B ⧸ I) := (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ B I).toLinearMap
    61	  have hsP : relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s ∈ P := by
    62	    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨s, hsK⟩, rfl⟩
    63	  have hfs : f (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) = 0 := by
    64	    change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) = 0
    65	    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
    66	  have hzero := RankOneFibre.subsingleton_map_tensor_of_span_singleton
    67	    P f (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) hsP (by
    68	      · intro v
    69	        exact hspan v) (by
    70	      · exact hfs)
    71	  change Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) at hzero
    72	  exact hzero
    73	
    74	end ThetaGeneratorSeed
    75	
    76	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# Rank-one fibre quotients
    11	
    12	If a vector `1 ⊗ s` is nonzero in a one-dimensional fibre `K ⊗[B] M`, then it spans that
    13	fibre.  Consequently, every surjective image of `M` that kills `s` has zero `K`-fibre.
    14	
    15	The mapped-submodule form is tailored to an ideal `J ≤ B`: if the fibre of `J` has rank one,
    16	`s ∈ J` survives in that fibre, and a quotient map kills `s`, then the image of `J` in the
    17	quotient has zero residue-field fibre.  This is purely right exactness of tensor product;
    18	neither flatness nor finite generation over `B` is needed at this step.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open scoped TensorProduct
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	namespace RankOneFibre
    30	
    31	/-- A surjective image has zero field fibre when every source-fibre vector is a scalar multiple
    32	of `1 ⊗ s`, and the image kills `s`.  The spanning hypothesis also covers the zero-fibre case;
    33	no dimension or nonzero-vector assumption is required. -/
    34	theorem subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton
    35	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    36	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    37	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (s : M)
    38	    (hspan : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] M, ∃ c : K, c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s) = v)
    39	    (hfs : f s = 0) :
    40	    Subsingleton (N ⊗[B] K) := by
    41	  have hft : Function.Surjective (f.lTensor K) :=
    42	    LinearMap.lTensor_surjective K hf
    43	  have hzero : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] M, (f.lTensor K) v = 0 := by
    44	    intro v
    45	    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan v
    46	    rw [← hc, ← TensorProduct.tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul c s,
    47	      LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, hfs]
    48	    simp
    49	  have hsub : Subsingleton (K ⊗[B] N) := by
    50	    refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
    51	    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hft x
    52	    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hft y
    53	    rw [hzero x', hzero y']
    54	  exact (TensorProduct.comm B N K).toEquiv.subsingleton
    55	
    56	/-- A surjective image of a module has zero field fibre if it kills a nonzero vector spanning
    57	the one-dimensional source fibre. -/
    58	theorem subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_finrank_eq_one
    59	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    60	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    61	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (s : M)
    62	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] M) = 1)
    63	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s ≠ 0) (hfs : f s = 0) :
    64	    Subsingleton (N ⊗[B] K) := by
    65	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton f hf s
    66	  · intro v
    67	    exact exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one hfin hs v
    68	  · exact hfs
    69	
    70	/-- If a linear map kills a generator of a one-dimensional source fibre, the fibre of its
    71	range is zero. -/
    72	theorem subsingleton_range_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
    73	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    74	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    75	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M)
    76	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] M) = 1)
    77	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s ≠ 0) (hfs : f s = 0) :
    78	    Subsingleton ((LinearMap.range f) ⊗[B] K) := by
    79	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_finrank_eq_one f.rangeRestrict
    80	    (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict f) s hfin hs
    81	  apply Subtype.ext
    82	  exact hfs
    83	
    84	/-- Range specialization of `subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton`. -/
    85	theorem subsingleton_range_tensor_of_span_singleton
    86	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
    87	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    88	    (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M)
    89	    (hspan : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] M, ∃ c : K, c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s) = v)
    90	    (hfs : f s = 0) :
    91	    Subsingleton ((LinearMap.range f) ⊗[B] K) := by
    92	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton f.rangeRestrict
    93	    (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict f) s hspan
    94	  apply Subtype.ext
    95	  exact hfs
    96	
    97	/-- Let `P` be a submodule whose field fibre is one-dimensional.  If `s ∈ P` survives in
    98	that fibre and `f s = 0`, then the fibre of the image `f(P)` is zero.
    99	
   100	For a chart ideal `J` and the quotient map `B → B/(s)`, the conclusion is precisely the
   101	vanishing of the fibre of the image of `J` in `B/(s)`. -/
   102	theorem subsingleton_map_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
   103	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
   104	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
   105	    (P : Submodule B M) (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M) (hsP : s ∈ P)
   106	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] P) = 1)
   107	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P) ≠ 0) (hfs : f s = 0) :
   108	    Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] K) := by
   109	  rw [← LinearMap.range_domRestrict P f]
   110	  apply subsingleton_range_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
   111	    (f.domRestrict P) (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P) hfin hs
   112	  simpa using hfs
   113	
   114	/-- Mapped-submodule specialization of `subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_span_singleton`.
   115	This is useful when the source ideal fibre may itself be zero. -/
   116	theorem subsingleton_map_tensor_of_span_singleton
   117	    {B K M N : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
   118	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
   119	    (P : Submodule B M) (f : M →ₗ[B] N) (s : M) (hsP : s ∈ P)
   120	    (hspan : ∀ v : K ⊗[B] P, ∃ c : K,
   121	      c • ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P)) = v) (hfs : f s = 0) :
   122	    Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] K) := by
   123	  rw [← LinearMap.range_domRestrict P f]
   124	  apply subsingleton_range_tensor_of_span_singleton
   125	    (f.domRestrict P) (⟨s, hsP⟩ : P) hspan
   126	  simpa using hfs
   127	
   128	/-- Quotienting by a vector that survives and spans a one-dimensional field fibre produces
   129	a quotient with zero field fibre. -/
   130	theorem subsingleton_quotient_span_tensor_of_finrank_eq_one
   131	    {B K M : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field K] [Algebra B K]
   132	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M]
   133	    (s : M) (hfin : Module.finrank K (K ⊗[B] M) = 1)
   134	    (hs : (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] s ≠ 0) :
   135	    Subsingleton ((M ⧸ Submodule.span B ({s} : Set M)) ⊗[B] K) := by
   136	  apply subsingleton_tensor_of_surjective_of_finrank_eq_one
   137	    (Submodule.span B ({s} : Set M)).mkQ
   138	    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _) s hfin hs
   139	  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
   140	  exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self s
   141	
   142	end RankOneFibre
   143	
   144	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	
    10	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
    11	ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
    12	modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
    13	that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
    14	`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
    15	`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
    16	restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.
    17	
    18	This is deliberately only the native-module bridge.  It does not assert
    19	`IsLineBundle`, pushforward base-change, or existence of a tied
    20	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation`; those remain genuine producer obligations.
    21	-/

    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

    44	The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws

    47	    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    48	      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
    49	  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    50	    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
    51	  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    52	      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    53	    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
    54	  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    55	    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    56	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    57	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)

   366	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization_over

   373	  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization pi h x]

   388	  exact x.2

   392	theorem rankOneRepresenterRestriction_factorization_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen

   399	        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen pi hPic))).app T y = x.1 :=

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/

   422	/-! ## Local-away generators for the canonical evaluation -/
   423	
   424	/-- Nonvanishing on every residue-field fibre of `D(f)` survives passage from the
   425	corresponding prime of the original ring to the residue field of a prime of `A_f`.
   426	
   427	The residue-field comparison is an isomorphism because localization induces bijective
   428	residue-field maps.  Keeping this as a private module lemma prevents the rank-one
   429	construction from depending on a false definitional transitivity of datum base change. -/
   430	private theorem fibre_tmul_ne_zero_of_away
   431	    {A Q : Type u} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q]
   432	    (f : A) (y : Q)
   433	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   434	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   435	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   436	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   437	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   438	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   439	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   440	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
   441	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   442	    intro hf
   443	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   444	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)
   445	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f
   446	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   447	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   448	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
   449	      (hy p hfp)
   450	    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
   451	  have hcom : p.asIdeal =
   452	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   453	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   454	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
   455	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom
   456	  have hrho : Function.Bijective rho :=
   457	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   458	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
   459	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom
   460	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   461	    LinearEquiv.ofBijective rho.toLinearMap hrho
   462	  have he := (e.rTensor Q).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hp
   463	  simpa only [LinearEquiv.rTensor_tmul, e, LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply,
   464	    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_one] using he

   466	/-- Cancelling an iterated scalar extension preserves a nonzero pure tensor. -/
   467	private theorem one_tmul_one_tmul_ne_zero

   469	    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R K] [Algebra S K] [IsScalarTower R S K]

   624	/-- A rank-one presentation has a tied local-away evaluation generator.

   626	The rank-one field of `P` makes every residue-field fibre of its `H⁰` module nontrivial.

   628	one datum section `y` which stays nonzero on every residue fibre over that open.  The same

   630	counit; the final conjunct records that counit identity explicitly so the future
   631	`divisorOfRankOne` construction consumes this witness rather than an unrelated section.

   633	theorem exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator
   634	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   635	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   636	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   637	      ∃ y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0,
   638	        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   639	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   640	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   641	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) ∧
   642	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   643	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   644	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   645	          (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   646	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   647	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   648	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective

   650	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) = 1 := by
   651	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]
   652	    exact P.h0_rank_one p
   653	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) :=
   654	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   655	  haveI : Nontrivial (Q ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   656	    (TensorProduct.comm P.cover.Carrier _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial

   658	    Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p (Q := Q)

   661	  · simpa only [Q] using hy
   662	  · exact P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y

    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the

    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.

    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism

    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =

    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩

    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_

/-

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus

/-!
# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum

`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.

This is deliberately only the native-module bridge.  It does not assert
`IsLineBundle`, pushforward base-change, or existence of a tied
`PicRankOneLocalPresentation`; those remain genuine producer obligations.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

noncomputable section

variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)

/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.

The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)

/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    intro X Y f r m
    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])

/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/
noncomputable def nativeModule : (relCurve C B).Modules := by
  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
  all_goals rfl

/-- On every open, restricting `D.nativeModule` to the coefficient ring recovers
the datum's original module of sections.

The equivalence is the identity on sections. Its linearity is the substantive
point: `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies the native structure-sheaf action
of a coefficient scalar with the datum's coefficient action. -/
noncomputable def nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv
    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[B]
      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) := by
  let f :
      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
        (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) →ₗ[B]
        D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := by
        intros
        rfl
      map_smul' := by

the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)

def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)

theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
  rfl

  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens

import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafPair
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RigidEngine4Relative

/-!
# The pinned cocycle datum on the relative curve (DAT-1, stage 1d-i, the datum)

The **cocycle datum over a `k`-algebra `B`** of the Wave-4 datum worksheet §3.2
(BINDING; `informal/spec-dat-1.md` §0), on the pinned relative cover
`relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)` of the relative curve `C_B`:

* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCoverData` — the two finite index types `J₀, J₁`, the
  basic-open generators `h_j ∈ Γ(Vᵢᴮ, 𝒪)` and the partition witnesses
  `∑ j, a_j · h_j = 1` per pinned chart; `pieces` sends `J₀ ⊕ J₁` to the basic opens
  `D(h_j)`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum` — the cover data together with the
  transition units on the pairwise basic-open overlaps (`Units` bundle the inverse
  witnesses) and the cocycle law `Scheme.IsGluingCocycle`.
* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` — the glued sheaf of `B`-modules of the datum
  (`gluedSheaf`), with the quasi-coherence packagings on **both pinned charts** and on
  the **overlap** as instances (`instQcohOn₀/₁/Inf`, from `gluedQcohOn`: side-`i`'s own
  family on chart `i`; side-0's family restricted along `V₀ᴮ ⊓ V₁ᴮ ≤ V₀ᴮ` on the
  overlap, through the subordinate-pieces interface).
* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.pairData` — the two-cover pair data at the pinned relative
  coordinates `t₀ᴮ, t₁ᴮ` (`relFiberCoord₀/₁`), through `gluedPairData` (the
  componentwise-action hypotheses are `rfl` for the keyed instances).

The engine keystones fired on `pairData.pair` are in
`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafEngine`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k)

/-- **The basic-open cover data over `B`** (worksheet §3.2, first half): finite index
types `J₀, J₁`, for `j ∈ Jᵢ` a section `h_j` of the pinned chart `Vᵢᴮ` with partition
witnesses `∑ j, a_j · h_j = 1` in `Γ(Vᵢᴮ, 𝒪)` — so the basic opens `D(h_j)` cover the
chart (`le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one`). -/
structure BasicOpenCoverData [IsAffineHom π] : Type (u + 1) where
  /-- The chart-0 index. -/
  J₀ : Type u
  /-- The chart-1 index. -/
  J₁ : Type u
  /-- The chart-0 index is finite. -/
  fintype₀ : Fintype J₀
  /-- The chart-1 index is finite. -/
  fintype₁ : Fintype J₁
  /-- The chart-0 basic-open generators. -/
  h₀ : J₀ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
  /-- The chart-1 basic-open generators. -/
  h₁ : J₁ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
  /-- The chart-0 partition coefficients. -/
  a₀ : J₀ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
  /-- The chart-1 partition coefficients. -/
  a₁ : J₁ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
  /-- The chart-0 partition witness. -/
  partition₀ : ∑ j : J₀, a₀ j * h₀ j = 1
  /-- The chart-1 partition witness. -/
  partition₁ : ∑ j : J₁, a₁ j * h₁ j = 1

attribute [instance] BasicOpenCoverData.fintype₀ BasicOpenCoverData.fintype₁

namespace BasicOpenCoverData

variable {C B π} [IsAffineHom π] (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B π)

/-- The gluing index of the datum, `J = J₀ ⊕ J₁`. -/
abbrev index : Type u := D.J₀ ⊕ D.J₁

/-- The pieces of the datum: the basic opens `D(h_j)` of the two pinned charts. -/
noncomputable def pieces : D.index → (relCurve C B).Opens :=
  Sum.elim (fun j => (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₀ j))
    (fun j => (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₁ j))

@[simp]
lemma pieces_inl (j : D.J₀) :
    D.pieces (Sum.inl j) = (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₀ j) := rfl

@[simp]
lemma pieces_inr (j : D.J₁) :
    D.pieces (Sum.inr j) = (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₁ j) := rfl

/-- The chart-0 pieces cover the pinned chart `V₀ᴮ`. -/
lemma cover₀ : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ≤
    ⨆ j : D.J₀, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₀ j) :=
  le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one D.a₀ D.h₀ D.partition₀

/-- The chart-1 pieces cover the pinned chart `V₁ᴮ`. -/
lemma cover₁ : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤
    ⨆ j : D.J₁, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.h₁ j) :=
  le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one D.a₁ D.h₁ D.partition₁

/-- The chart-0 generators, restricted to the overlap of the pinned charts. -/
noncomputable def hInf (j : D.J₀) :
    Γ(relCurve C B,
      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) :=
  (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left (D.h₀ j)

/-- The restricted chart-0 pieces are subordinate to the pieces of the datum. -/
lemma basicOpen_hInf_le (j : D.J₀) :
    (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.hInf j) ≤ D.pieces (Sum.inl j) := by
  rw [hInf, Scheme.basicOpen_resHom, pieces_inl]
  exact inf_le_right

/-- The restricted chart-0 pieces cover the overlap of the pinned charts (the
partition witness restricts to a partition witness). -/
lemma coverInf : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
    ≤ ⨆ j : D.J₀, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.hInf j) := by
  refine le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one
    (fun j => (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left (D.a₀ j)) D.hInf ?_
  have hres := congrArg
    ((relCurve C B).resHom (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀))
    D.partition₀
  rw [map_sum, map_one] at hres
  rw [← hres]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm

end BasicOpenCoverData

/-- **The pinned cocycle datum over `B`** (worksheet §3.2, VERBATIM): the basic-open
cover data of the two pinned charts together with transition units on the pairwise
basic-open overlaps (with explicit inverse witnesses — `Units`) satisfying the cocycle
identities in the overlap section rings (`Scheme.IsGluingCocycle`, including the
normalization `g j j = 1`). This is the DAT-1 constructor input and the object RE-5
descends. -/
structure BasicOpenCocycleDatum [IsAffineHom π] : Type (u + 1) extends
    BasicOpenCoverData C B π where
  /-- The transition units on the pairwise piece overlaps. -/
  unit : ∀ i j : toBasicOpenCoverData.index,
    Γ(relCurve C B, toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces i ⊓ toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces j)ˣ
  /-- The cocycle law. -/
  isGluingCocycle : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces unit

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

variable {C B π} [IsAffineHom π] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)

/-- **The glued sheaf of the datum**: the m-chart cocycle-glued sheaf of `B`-modules on
the small Zariski site of the relative curve `C_B`. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def sheaf :
    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
      (ModuleCat.{u} B) :=
  gluedSheaf B D.pieces D.unit

/-- The quasi-coherence packaging of the datum's glued sheaf on the pinned chart
`V₀ᴮ`, from the chart-0 family. -/
noncomputable instance instQcohOn₀ :
    Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ :=
  gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle (σ := Sum.inl) (h := D.h₀)
    (fun _ => le_rfl) D.cover₀

/-- The quasi-coherence packaging on the pinned chart `V₁ᴮ`, from the chart-1
family. -/
noncomputable instance instQcohOn₁ :
    Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :=
  gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle (σ := Sum.inr) (h := D.h₁)
    (fun _ => le_rfl) D.cover₁

/-- The quasi-coherence packaging on the overlap of the pinned charts, from the
restricted chart-0 family (the subordinate-pieces interface). -/
noncomputable instance instQcohOnInf :
    Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf
      ((relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) :=
  gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle
    (σ := fun j : D.J₀ => Sum.inl j) (h := D.hInf)
    (fun j => D.basicOpen_hInf_le j) D.coverInf

/-- **The two-cover pair data of the datum's glued sheaf** at the pinned relative chart
coordinates `t₀ᴮ, t₁ᴮ`: overlap-as-basic-open from the landed
`relCover_fiberTwoCover_inf_eq_basicOpen₀/₁`, mutual inverse from the pulled-back
`P1.chartCoord` relation `relFiberCoord_mul`. Its `pair` is the two-lattice pair of the
datum's sheaf that the rigid engine consumes. -/
noncomputable def pairData :
    Scheme.TwoCoverPairData D.sheaf (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
      (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :=
  gluedPairData B D.pieces D.unit
    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
    (relFiberCoord₀ C B π) (relFiberCoord₁ C B π)
    (relCover_fiberTwoCover_inf_eq_basicOpen₀ C B π)
    (relCover_fiberTwoCover_inf_eq_basicOpen₁ C B π)
    (relFiberCoord_mul C B π)

end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-- **The m-chart glued sheaf** of transition units `g i j ∈ Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ` on the
pieces `U : J → X.Opens`: the sheaf of `k`-modules on the small Zariski site of `X`
whose sections over `W` are the families `s ∈ Π j, Γ(W ⊓ U j)` with `s i = g i j · s j`
on every double overlap. For a cocycle (`Scheme.IsGluingCocycle`) on a covering family
this is the line bundle presented by the cocycle, trivialized on each piece
(`gluedTriv`). -/
noncomputable def gluedSheaf :
    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X : TopCat)) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
  ⟨gluedPresheaf k U g, isSheaf_gluedPresheaf k U g⟩

@[simp]
lemma gluedSheaf_obj (W : X.Opens) :
    (gluedSheaf k U g).obj.obj (op W) = ModuleCat.of k ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W) := rfl

lemma secRes_gluedSheaf {W' W : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
    secRes (gluedSheaf k U g) h s = gluedRes k U g h s := rfl

/-! ## The piece trivializations -/

section Triv

variable {U} {g}
variable (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)

/-- **Piece trivialization**: over `W ≤ U j`, the `j`-th component is a `k`-linear
equivalence `F_g(W) ≃ₗ[k] Γ(X, W)` (the inverse rebuilds every component through the
transition units `g i j`; the cocycle law makes the rebuilt family match). -/
noncomputable def gluedTriv (j : J) {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ U j) :
    ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W) ≃ₗ[k] Γ(X, W) where
  toFun s := X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW) (s.val j)
  map_add' s t := map_add _ _ _
  map_smul' r s := resHom_smul' k _ r _
  invFun t := ⟨fun i =>
    X.resHom (le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans hW) : W ⊓ U i ≤ U i ⊓ U j)
        (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
      X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U i ≤ W) t, by
    intro i i'
    have hO : W ⊓ U i ⊓ U i' ≤ U i ⊓ U i' ⊓ U j :=
      le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right)
        ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans hW)
    have hcoc := hc.mul_res_of_le hO
    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
    rw [← hcoc, mul_assoc]⟩
  left_inv s := by
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun i => ?_)
    have hloc := (mem_gluedSubmodule_iff k U g (s.val :
      ∀ l : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U l))).mp s.property i j
    have key := congrArg
      (X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl (inf_le_left.trans hW) :
        W ⊓ U i ≤ W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j)) hloc
    rw [map_mul] at key
    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
    rw [Scheme.resHom_self] at key
    change X.resHom (le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans hW))
        (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
        X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U i ≤ W)
          (X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW) (s.val j)) = s.val i
    rw [Scheme.resHom_resHom, ← key]
  right_inv t := by
    change X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW)
        (X.resHom (le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans hW) : W ⊓ U j ≤ U j ⊓ U j)
            (g j j : Γ(X, U j ⊓ U j)) *
          X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U j ≤ W) t) = t
    rw [map_mul, hc.unit_self j, map_one, map_one, one_mul, Scheme.resHom_resHom,
      Scheme.resHom_self]

lemma gluedTriv_apply (j : J) {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ U j)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
    gluedTriv k hc j hW s = X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl hW) (s.val j) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
lemma gluedTriv_symm_coe (j : J) {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ U j) (t : Γ(X, W)) (i : J) :
    ((gluedTriv k hc j hW).symm t).val i =
      X.resHom (le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans hW) : W ⊓ U i ≤ U i ⊓ U j)
          (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
        X.resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U i ≤ W) t :=
  rfl

/-- The piece trivialization commutes with restriction. -/
lemma gluedTriv_res (j : J) {W' W : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) (hW : W ≤ U j)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
    gluedTriv k hc j (h.trans hW) (gluedRes k U g h s) =
      X.resHom h (gluedTriv k hc j hW s) := by
  rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe]
  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]

/-- **Cross-piece comparison of the trivializations**: on an open below two pieces the
trivializations differ by the transition unit, `triv_i = g i j · triv_j` — the m-chart
mirror of `twistTriv₀_inf_eq`. -/
lemma gluedTriv_eq_unit_mul (i j : J) {W : X.Opens} (hWi : W ≤ U i) (hWj : W ≤ U j)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g W)) :
    gluedTriv k hc i hWi s =
      X.resHom (le_inf hWi hWj : W ≤ U i ⊓ U j) (g i j : Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)) *
        gluedTriv k hc j hWj s := by
  have hloc := (mem_gluedSubmodule_iff k U g (s.val :
    ∀ l : J, Γ(X, W ⊓ U l))).mp s.property i j
  have key := congrArg
    (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf le_rfl hWi) hWj : W ≤ W ⊓ U i ⊓ U j)) hloc
  rw [map_mul] at key
  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
  rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedTriv_apply]
  exact key

end Triv

end GluedSheaf

/-!
# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum

`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.

This is deliberately only the native-module bridge.  It does not assert
`IsLineBundle`, pushforward base-change, or existence of a tied
`PicRankOneLocalPresentation`; those remain genuine producer obligations.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

noncomputable section

variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)

/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.

The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)

/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    intro X Y f r m
    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])

/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/
noncomputable def nativeModule : (relCurve C B).Modules := by
  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
  all_goals rfl

/-- On every open, restricting `D.nativeModule` to the coefficient ring recovers
the datum's original module of sections.

The equivalence is the identity on sections. Its linearity is the substantive
point: `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies the native structure-sheaf action
of a coefficient scalar with the datum's coefficient action. -/
noncomputable def nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv
    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[B]
      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) := by
  let f :
      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
        (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) →ₗ[B]
        D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := by
        intros
        rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro r x
        change gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
            ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B U r) x =
          r • (show D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) from x)
        exact gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap B D.pieces D.unit
          (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x }
  exact LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun y => ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩

/-- The base-ring sheaf of `D.nativeModule` is canonically the datum sheaf.

This has exactly the type of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.module_iso` when the
presentation's native module is chosen to be `D.nativeModule`. -/
noncomputable def nativeModuleKSheafIso :
    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D) ≅ D.sheaf :=
  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
    (NatIso.ofComponents
      (fun U => (nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv D U.unop).toModuleIso)
      (fun {_ _} _ => by
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        rfl))

end

end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

end AlgebraicGeometry
